description: This file contains functions and classes for token counting, encoding selection, message pruning, and chat message management in a language model context, specifically for handling token limits and message history in LLM interactions.

classes.name: LlamaEncoding
classes.description: A class implementing the Encoding interface, providing encode and decode methods using llamaTokenizer.

methods.name: modelUsesGptTokenizer
methods.description: Determines if a model name indicates usage of a GPT tokenizer based on pattern matching.

methods.name: encodingForModel
methods.description: Returns the appropriate encoding object for a given model name, defaulting to llamaEncoding if not GPT.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts the number of tokens in a MessageContent, defaulting to llama2 tokenizer.

methods.name: countChatMessageTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens in a ChatMessage, including role and content.

methods.name: extractToolSequence
methods.description: Extracts and validates the user message from the end of a message array.

methods.name: pruneLinesFromTop
methods.description: Removes lines from the top of a prompt until within max token limit.

methods.name: pruneLinesFromBottom
methods.description: Removes lines from the bottom of a prompt until within max token limit.

methods.name: pruneStringFromBottom
methods.description: Truncates a string from the end to fit within max tokens.

methods.name: pruneStringFromTop
methods.description: Truncates a string from the start to fit within max tokens.

methods.name: getTokenCountingBufferSafety
methods.description: Calculates a safety buffer for token counting based on context length.

methods.name: pruneRawPromptFromTop
methods.description: Prunes a prompt from the top considering context length and tokens for completion.

methods.name: compileChatMessages
methods.description: Reconciles chat messages with available context length, pruning older messages while preserving critical elements.
